purpose: Blindly test whether the unfitted TAYLOR3 curvature indicator transfers as a grid-risk ranking diagnostic to previously unused soil textures.

trigger_authority.forbidden_interpretation: TAYLOR3 is a ranking/risk indicator only. MECH4A rejected its use as a signed flux correction.

external_materials.source: Carsel and Parrish (1988) USDA textural-class van Genuchten parameters as reproduced in HYDRUS; Mualem l=0.5
external_materials.selection_rule: Three previously unused textural classes spanning moderately coarse to fine behavior, frozen before any MECH4B trajectory.

reference_experiment.geometry: 16 x 10 cm homogeneous fine Reference column
reference_experiment.bottom_boundary: fixed flux K0 in normalized positive-downward convention

ranking_experiment.actual_error: RMS over pulse steps of exact-layer-mean gradient minus 10-cm fine central gradient, identical to normalized MECH1 E_gradient

minimum_reference_authority.material_usable: At least one qualified WET and one qualified DRY case for a material.
minimum_reference_authority.panel_sufficient: At least two of three materials usable and at least 10 qualified WET/DRY cases overall.

casewise: Spearman rank correlation across L between each indicator and actual RMS error
actual peak L and indicator peak L
aggregate: median Spearman across all qualified cases
per_material: median Spearman for TAYLOR3 and LENGTH_ONLY
median peak error for TAYLOR3 and LENGTH_ONLY

adjudication.dominance_definition: TAYLOR3 aggregate median Spearman >= LENGTH_ONLY, median peak error <= LENGTH_ONLY, exact peak hits >= LENGTH_ONLY, with at least one strict improvement.
adjudication.material_consistency: For every usable material, TAYLOR3 median Spearman must be strictly greater than LENGTH_ONLY median Spearman and TAYLOR3 median peak error must be no greater.
adjudication.CURVATURE_RISK_RANKING_TRANSFER_SUPPORTE: Panel sufficient, aggregate dominance holds, and material consistency holds for every usable material.
adjudication.CURVATURE_RISK_RANKING_TRANSFER_PARTIAL: Panel sufficient and aggregate dominance holds, but at least one usable material fails material consistency.
adjudication.CURVATURE_RISK_RANKING_TRANSFER_NOT_SUPP: Panel sufficient and aggregate dominance fails.

interpretation_firewalls: A supported result validates only ordering of interface risk over this frozen L ladder, not the magnitude or sign of the gradient error.
No Taylor coefficient may be fitted from MECH4B.
No material may be removed because it weakens transfer.
No application-specific layer size is selected from this experiment.
A supported result may justify a curvature-based adaptive fixed-grid diagnostic; it does not authorize moving meshes or production ROM.
